chunks.title: Account Help
chunks.text:
Resetting your password

Go to the login page and click "Forgot password." Enter your account
email and a reset link is sent immediately — it expires after 1 hour.
If you don't receive the email within a few minutes, check spam and
confirm you're using the email address your account was created with.

chunks.title: Account Help
chunks.text:
Getting locked out

After 5 failed login attempts, the account is temporarily locked for 30
minutes as a security measure. You can also reset your password
immediately to unlock the account right away instead of waiting.

chunks.title: Account Help
chunks.text:
Two-factor authentication (2FA)

2FA can be enabled under Settings > Security. It uses any standard
authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.). When you enable
2FA, you're given 10 single-use recovery codes — store these somewhere
safe, since losing both your authenticator app and your recovery codes
means account recovery requires manual identity verification with
support.

chunks.title: Account Help
chunks.text:
Changing your account email

Settings > Account > Email. A confirmation link is sent to the new
address; the change only takes effect once that link is clicked, so your
old email keeps working until then.

chunks.title: Account Help
chunks.text:
"I can't log in" checklist

1. Confirm you're using the exact email your account was created with.
2. Clear your browser cache or try an incognito/private window.
3. If your company uses SSO, log in through your company's SSO portal
   instead of the regular email/password form.
4. If none of the above works, use "Forgot password" to reset your
   credentials rather than repeatedly retrying, to avoid the 5-attempt
   lockout.

chunks.title: Billing FAQ
chunks.text:
When am I charged?

Monthly plans are charged on the same day of the month as your original
signup date. Annual plans are charged once a year on your renewal date.
You can see your next charge date under Settings > Billing.

chunks.title: Billing FAQ
chunks.text:
Why was I charged twice this month?

This is almost always one of two things: a plan upgrade (which charges a
prorated amount in addition to your regular renewal) or a genuine billing
error. Check Settings > Billing > Invoice History first — if you see two
charges of the same amount on the same day with no plan change, that's a
duplicate charge. See `refund-policy.md` for how duplicate charges are
refunded.

chunks.title: Billing FAQ
chunks.text:
What payment methods are accepted?

Credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) and PayPal.
Bank transfer is available on the Business plan only, arranged directly
with support.

chunks.title: Billing FAQ
chunks.text:
How do I update my card on file?

Settings > Billing > Payment Method > Update. The new card is used
starting with your next scheduled charge; it does not retroactively
affect past charges.

chunks.title: Billing FAQ
chunks.text:
Can I get an invoice or receipt?

Yes. Every charge generates an invoice automatically, available under
Settings > Billing > Invoice History as a downloadable PDF.

chunks.title: Billing FAQ
chunks.text:
What happens if a payment fails?

A failed payment is retried up to 3 times over 7 days. You'll get an
email after each failed attempt. If all 3 retries fail, the account is
suspended until a valid payment method is added — your data is not
deleted at this stage, only access is paused.

chunks.title: Cancellation Policy
chunks.text:
How to cancel

Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel Subscription and confirm. Cancellation
takes effect immediately in the sense that no future charges are
scheduled, but your plan features remain active until the end of the
current billing period.

chunks.title: Cancellation Policy
chunks.text:
What happens to your access

You keep full access to your current plan (Starter, Pro, or Business —
see `subscription-plans.md`) until the end of the billing period you've
already paid for. After that date, the account moves to a read-only,
free-tier state: you can log in and view past tickets, but shared inbox
automation rules and integrations are paused.

chunks.title: Cancellation Policy
chunks.text:
What happens to your data

Your account data (tickets, automation rules, integration connections) is
retained for 30 days after the billing period ends, in case you want to
reactivate. After 30 days of inactivity on a cancelled account, the data
is permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

chunks.title: Cancellation Policy
chunks.text:
Refunds on cancellation

Cancelling does not automatically trigger a refund for the current billing
period — you keep access through the period you already paid for. If you
were charged again after cancelling, see the "Refunds after cancellation"
section in `refund-policy.md`.

chunks.title: Cancellation Policy
chunks.text:
Reactivating

You can reactivate any time before the 30-day data retention window ends
by resubscribing to any plan from Settings > Billing. Reactivating after
that window means starting with a fresh account.

chunks.title: Refund Policy
chunks.text:
Eligibility window

Charges are eligible for a full refund if the refund request is made within
14 days of the charge date. This applies to both monthly and annual billing
cycles — for annual plans, the 14-day window starts from the most recent
renewal charge, not the original signup date.

chunks.title: Refund Policy
chunks.text:
Refunds after cancellation

If you cancel your subscription but are charged again before the
cancellation takes effect (for example, a renewal that processed moments
before you cancelled), that charge is refunded automatically within 5
business days. You do not need to contact support for this case. See
`cancellation-policy.md` for how cancellation timing works.

chunks.title: Refund Policy
chunks.text:
Duplicate or billing-error charges

Duplicate charges caused by a billing system error are refunded in full
regardless of the 14-day window, as soon as the duplicate is confirmed.
Contact support with the charge dates and amounts so the team can verify
the duplicate before issuing the refund.

chunks.title: Refund Policy
chunks.text:
What is not refundable

Charges older than 14 days are not refundable, except for the duplicate or
billing-error case above. Partial-month usage is not prorated for refund
purposes — refunds are issued for the full charge amount or not at all.

chunks.title: Refund Policy
chunks.text:
How to request a refund

Email support with your account email and the date of the charge you're
disputing. Most requests are resolved within 1 business day; approved
refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5-10 business
days, depending on your bank.

chunks.title: Subscription Plans
chunks.text:
Starter — $9/month

For individuals getting started. Includes 1 user seat, up to 500 support
tickets per month, and email support with a 1 business day response time.
No automation rules or shared inbox.

chunks.title: Subscription Plans
chunks.text:
Pro — $29/month

For small support teams. Includes up to 5 user seats, unlimited tickets,
a shared inbox with automation rules, and priority support with same-day
response. This is the most popular plan.

chunks.title: Subscription Plans
chunks.text:
Business — $79/month

For growing teams that need more control. Includes up to 20 user seats,
everything in Pro, advanced automation rules, single sign-on (SSO), and a
dedicated account manager.

chunks.title: Subscription Plans
chunks.text:
Annual billing

Paying annually instead of monthly gives a 20% discount on any plan. The
discount is applied automatically at checkout when you select "Bill
annually."

chunks.title: Subscription Plans
chunks.text:
Changing plans

Upgrading takes effect immediately and you're charged a prorated amount
for the rest of the current billing period. Downgrading takes effect at
the start of your next billing period — you keep your current plan's
features until then, and there is no partial refund for downgrading
mid-period.

chunks.title: Subscription Plans
chunks.text:
Seat limits

If your team grows beyond your plan's seat limit, you'll be prompted to
upgrade before adding the next user. Removing a user frees up a seat
immediately.

chunks.title: Troubleshooting
chunks.text:
The application keeps crashing or freezing

First, check the status page for any ongoing incident — most sudden,
widespread crashes are on our end, not yours. If the status page is
clear: clear your browser cache, make sure your browser is updated to
the latest version, and try disabling browser extensions one at a time,
since ad blockers and privacy extensions are the most common cause of
this symptom.

chunks.title: Troubleshooting
chunks.text:
Attachments fail to upload

Attachments must be under 25MB and in a supported format (PDF, PNG, JPG,
CSV, DOCX). Uploads that fail partway through are usually a network
issue rather than a file problem — try a different network or disable
any VPN. If a specific file consistently fails under the size limit,
contact support with the file type and size so it can be investigated.

chunks.title: Troubleshooting
chunks.text:
Shared inbox isn't syncing new emails

First check Settings > Integrations to confirm the email connection
still shows "Connected" — integrations occasionally need to be
reauthorized after the email provider revokes access (common after a
password change on the connected mailbox). New emails can also take up
to 15 minutes to appear during normal sync delay, which is expected
behavior, not a fault.

chunks.title: Troubleshooting
chunks.text:
Automation rules aren't triggering

Automation rules are only available on Pro and Business plans — confirm
your plan under Settings > Billing. If you're on an eligible plan, check
that the rule's trigger conditions match the incoming email exactly;
the most common cause is a trigger condition that's more specific than
intended (for example, matching an exact subject line instead of a
keyword).

chunks.title: Troubleshooting
chunks.text:
General steps before contacting support

Note the exact error message if one appears, the browser and OS you're
using, and roughly when the issue started. Including these details in
your first message to support significantly speeds up resolution.
